newsitem.title: PERU: Peru restructures $193 mln debt with U.K.
newsitem.headline: Peru restructures $193 mln debt with U.K.

text.p: The Peruvian government signed Monday a $193 million debt restructuring accord with the United Kingdom under the umbrella of its negotiations with Paris Club creditors.
Economy Minister Jorge Camet said the 20-year agreement, based on an interest rate around LIBOR, included a three-year grace period prior to a 1999-2015 payment schedule.
He added that this was the first bilateral restructuring accord Peru has signed since a preliminary restructuring agreement in July with 14 countries belonging to the Paris Club of creditors.
Camet predicted imminent similar agreements soon with Japan and Spain.
The $193 million corresponded to debt with the U.K. government's Export Credit Guarantee Department.
